'''Duelmania DownUnder 2021''' is the third installment of the Australian heavy Duelmania edition. 

As statistics showed, [[bravado]] was rarely or never played previously in Australia. That's why [[bravado2020]] along with the addition of the long lost map [[messy]]. A total of 16 players signed up.

===Format===
* Double Elimination Bracket
* No division or groups
* One round per week in UB, 2 rounds in LB
